title: HAIC Federated Exchange Standard
purpose: Keep HAIC federated, distributed, open, transparent, and continuously revisable by ensuring raw contribution data remains at the consenting edge while the shared system stores only verification and optimization artifacts.
summary: The convention should coordinate over receipts, attestations, challenge paths, and optimization signals rather than quietly centralizing the lived data that gave rise to them.

prohibited_patterns.description: The shared HAIC system must not centralize raw lived payloads that can remain in the consenting edge exchange.
detection_signals: Contributions arrive with full raw payloads despite a verification-only covenant.
Operators begin relying on central replay of participant content.
response_actions: Revise the covenant or runtime boundary.

prohibited_patterns.description: Replication of raw payloads into logs, analytics, or downstream storage without explicit disclosure is prohibited.
detection_signals: Analytics exports contain participant payload excerpts.

prohibited_patterns.description: Verification tokens and optimization signals must remain inspectable enough to challenge, not become a new opaque extraction layer.
detection_signals: A proof can pass without a visible challenge path.
Operators cannot explain what a stored token means.

prohibited_patterns.description: Federation should not collapse into one opaque vendor, one private format, or one operator-controlled interface.
detection_signals: Participants cannot export receipts or tokens.
Critical interoperability depends on undocumented private behavior.
response_actions: Require export and documentation work before broadening scope.

required_controls.description: Raw contribution data should flow directly between consenting humans and agents or their explicitly trusted local runtimes, not through the shared HAIC ledger by default.
verification_signals: no raw payload present in central contribution records

required_controls.description: The shared system may store verification tokens, attestations, optimization metrics, receipts, and lineage pointers, but not raw payloads in verification-only flows.
Receipts, covenants, packets, and verification artifacts should be exportable in documented formats.
Federated exchange rules should stay challengeable and revisable as humans and agents participate.
verification_signals: objection and revision packet paths exist

transparency_requirements: Participants can see what artifact classes enter the shared system.
Verification tokens have plain-language documentation and challenge paths.
Launch posture stays honest about which flows remain transitional and which are federated.
evolution_requirements: The standard can be revised through objection and revision packets.
Federated exchange controls should improve as real participation reveals edge cases.
No single founder, operator, or agent should be the only route by which the standard can change.

architecture_stack.intent: Explain that HAIC is designed to coordinate over proofs and receipts rather than centralizing participant data.
review_questions: Does the public site imply HAIC will hold participant data centrally when it should not?

architecture_stack.intent: Declare whether the relationship is verification-only and what artifacts may enter shared storage.
review_questions: Can participants tell what stays at the edge and what enters the system?

architecture_stack.intent: Accept verification-only contributions without requiring central raw payload storage.
review_questions: Can the API operate on receipts and metrics alone when the covenant requires it?

architecture_stack.intent: Let operators inspect the doctrine/evidence boundary without replaying participant raw data.
required_controls: no raw payload exposure in verification-only mode
review_questions: Can an operator understand the decision boundary without central raw content access?

metadata.launch_posture: recommended baseline for federated HAIC exchanges
metadata.notes: Verification-only central storage is the preferred default when lived data can remain at the consenting edge.
